### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via handleMetadataRequest (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via /metadata/:type (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx`  _(via /metadata/:type (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via /metadata/:type (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **33** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a88a1bb399ea1ba6d717b8f6fefa0b13ec3e66a8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `cf2e5eac053a95508155524a86e76e24a9085a07` — the merge of head `78c4bdfdc58960f6e5b17d37f81346ff5fcdada6` into base `a88a1bb399ea1ba6d717b8f6fefa0b13ec3e66a8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin cf2e5eac053a95508155524a86e76e24a9085a07 && git checkout cf2e5eac053a95508155524a86e76e24a9085a07
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a88a1bb399ea1ba6d717b8f6fefa0b13ec3e66a8 78c4bdfdc58960f6e5b17d37f81346ff5fcdada6 && git checkout -B drift-repro a88a1bb399ea1ba6d717b8f6fefa0b13ec3e66a8 && git merge --no-ff 78c4bdfdc58960f6e5b17d37f81346ff5fcdada6

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a88a1bb399ea1ba6d717b8f6fefa0b13ec3e66a8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a88a1bb399ea1ba6d717b8f6fefa0b13ec3e66a8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `78c4bdfdc58960f6e5b17d37f81346ff5fcdada6`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Every pure-draft door gated — correct.** Head census (`git grep` over `packages/*/src`, non-test, excluding spec/metadata layers) finds draft switches only in: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (`_drafts` :5731, list `?preview=draft` :5947, item `?state=draft` :6689, item `?preview=draft` :6697, dataset `body.previewDrafts`/`?preview=draft` :11316; PUT `?mode=draft` :7398 and DELETE `?state=draft` :7510 are write doors behind `metaSaveVerdict`/`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`); `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` (item :1087, list :1293, `_drafts` :1170). `service-analytics/src/plugin.ts` `draftRowsResolver` (:975-:1003) is reached only through `queryDataset(..., { previewDrafts })`, whose sole caller passing that option is the REST dataset door (:11393). `plugin-security` `probeUnpublishedDraft` (:8601) reads under `isSystem` on a refusal path and returns an existence word, no body. `packages/client/src/index.ts:891` sets the param client-side (not a door). MCP `mcp-server-runtime.ts:574` reads `getMetaItems({ type })` with no preview. `packages/qa` carries no draft pin. No missed door.
- **Single rule — correct.** Both helpers are byte-for-byte `return isObjectSchemaMaskExempt(caller);` (`rest-server.ts:1701`, `domains/meta.ts:164`); each census pins the body. Order: item read resolves `readCtx` :6679 before `isDraftRead` :6689 / `previewDrafts` :6697; every later consumer reads the admitted vars (cache fork :6791, `itemRequest` :6951-6952, `readPolicy` :7039); the uncached `stateParam` re-parse is gone (diff confirms). List: `listCtx` :5927 → `previewDrafts` :5947 → first read :5957 (`listRequest`), :5990 (`api` filter); nothing reads it earlier. Dataset: `context` resolved and `enforceAuth` run before :11316; reads at :11324, :11393. Dispatcher: both switches judge `_context.executionContext`, the same object `_drafts` judges at :1169. No raw `?state=`/`?preview=` read past a gated variable on any read door.
- **Absence answers byte-identical — correct.** For a non-admitted caller both switches are `false`, so the handler follows the plain read's exact path: same cache-arm decision, same `itemRequest`, same `{ arms: 'all', app: 'gate' }` policy, same headers (`Vary: Accept-Language` only, :7075). Real-stack pins (`meta-draft-read-builder-gate.test.ts`) assert `res.body toEqual plain.body` and envelope equality for: published-with-draft (`atlas`), draft-only (`beacon` → 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), no-draft (`quiet` → published, builder control gets `NO_DRAFT`), list, dataset (published definition, `options` undefined; draft-only → 404 `NOT_FOUND`, nothing queried; inline dataset → live rows). Cache: a builder's draft read always bypasses `getMetaItemCached` (`!isDraftRead && !previewDrafts`), so no draft ever enters the shared cache; a member's `?state=draft` on a cacheable type takes the cached arm exactly as the plain read. No cross-caller serve. Nit (not a defect): comment `rest-server.ts:6816-6822` 「this branch is unreachable when `previewDrafts` / `?state=draft` are set」 is now imprecise — the cached branch IS reached with `?state=draft` in the query for a non-admitted caller; its intent (no draft members on the cached read) still holds.
- **Builders unchanged — correct for the ruled predicate; one fact to record.** `readPolicy = isDraftRead ? STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY : …` (:7039) keeps #20337's author exemption; `manage_metadata` is in `OBJECT_SCHEMA_WRITE_CAPABILITIES` (`object-schema-fls.ts:72`), so an author is admitted and the real-stack #20290 pin still drives the whole read and the save round-trip. Fact on `manage_org_presentation` alone: `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict` (`meta-write-capability.ts:124-150`) admits that caller to save an org-scoped draft of an org-overridable type (`view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation`, `email_template` — `metadata-plugin.zod.ts:844-1060`; NOT `app`). Before this PR (merge base, PR #20337 head) any signed-in caller who could open the item got the draft on `?state=draft`, so that caller read back the draft they could save. Ruling A (`5861438413`) is worded 「serves an app whole to whoever may save it (`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`) … pruned to everyone else」 — `app` only, where `manage_org_presentation` can never save (pinned by the census presenter edge). After this PR, for `view`/`dashboard`/`report` that caller can `PUT ?mode=draft` but `?state=draft` answers the published row (404 for a draft-only one). Triage `5861173247` fixed the predicate as the `_drafts` check and said 「Nothing changes for a builder」; that predicate does not count this caller. The PR records it in Acceptance notes; the os-dev report raised it as an open question. Facts only; not ruled here.
- **Other cards' pins moved, not weakened — correct.** #20156 census: `readsDrafts` added per caller and cross-checked against `GET /meta/_drafts` for all four callers (new cell at :609); draft-door cells for `readsDrafts:false` assert the protocol was never asked `state:'draft'` AND body equals plain; `reader.ctx` already held `studio.access` (unchanged), so its draft cells still measure the draft branch; presenter edge keeps its pruned-on-all-four-doors assertion with `readsDrafts:false`. #20290 real-stack: the non-saver control moved to a `studio.access` builder and still asserts pruned + no per-deployment gate; the capability-less cell lives in the new file (published app, byte-identical). Five pins (absent-404 cache-divert, envelope draft branch, served-only `api` drafts view, rest.test forwarding ×2) now read as `studio.access` and still measure their branch; served-only adds the member's filtered answer. `meta-item-absent-404.test.ts`'s `setup` honours `perms` (:103, :121). No case dropped.
- **Pins prove it — correct for behaviour; census partially.** Per door: member cell, three builder controls, draft-only-404 cell — item (three switch spellings), list, dataset (two spellings), dispatcher item and list, plus a cross-door predicate cell on both transports. Census limitation: `isDraftSite` sees only `=== 'draft'` comparisons and `.previewDrafts`/`.listDrafts` accesses; a door that asks the protocol with a literal request property (`getMetaItem({ …, state: 'draft' })` or `previewDrafts: true` — the spelling `service-analytics` uses) is invisible. Its docblock concedes this; the PR body's 「A new draft door reddens it」 holds only for the switch-comparison spelling. Non-blocking; a follow-up could add `PropertyAssignment` rows.
- **`/diff` — confirmed at source.** REST `/diff` (:8206-8340) calls `diffMetaItem`, which reads `sys_metadata_history` with `where { organization_id, type, name }` and no state (`protocol.ts:21364-21370`); the repository's single `put` appends a history row for `state:'draft'` saves too (`sys-metadata-repository.ts` ~:672). Sides are judged under `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` only for `app`/`doc`/`book` (`gatesPerCaller` :3515), so a member who may open a published app reads a draft-save version pruned; a draft-only app is 404 (`diffCurrent == null`). Additional fact: for types `gatesPerCaller` is false for (e.g. `view`), `/diff` fetches no current document and applies no per-caller gate, so the draft-only 404 holds only for the three gated types. The dispatcher has no `/diff`, `/history` or `/layers` door. Leaving `/diff` to a separate card is consistent with the claim's file surface and with ruling B item 2 (non-authors get the plain read's pruned answer, never a refusal) — gating it changes a ruled door for every member. Correct.
- **Comments and docs — correct.** `apps.mdx:376-381` is true on the head and reconciles the paragraph's 「Every other caller reads it … in the draft」 with the gate. Added docblocks and inline comments match the code (`stateParam` removal, `readCtx` hoist, list declaration order). Read-only texts (`object-schema-fls.ts:79-80`, `protocol.ts:7782-7783`, :8159, the `2a29caa` changeset) are now true of every door taking a draft switch; only the stale nit at `rest-server.ts:6816-6822` remains inside the PR's own package.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/rest` patch, `@objectstack/runtime` patch, `Clause-②: no` — correct. The change pulls a served permission back to the declared contract (ADR-0106 D4, ADR-0037 Risks row, the `2a29caa` changeset 「declaration ≠ authorization … draft access stays admin-gated upstream」); no accept set moves (the parameters remain accepted; a non-admitted caller gets the plain 200/404, not a 400/403), the same shape ruling `5856774816` item 4 and #20193 took as patch. The changeset states plainly who could read before: 「every door that reads one, other than `/meta/_drafts`, served it to any signed-in caller who could open the item」, names the doors, the admitted set, the fallback answers, and that `/diff` and `/history` are unchanged.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Files outside the claim's surface: none. 13 files (API list = `git diff --stat 670471718…78c4bdfdc`): `rest-server.ts`, `domains/meta.ts`, three new tests and six edited tests under `packages/rest/src` / `packages/runtime/src/domains`, one `apps.mdx` sentence, one `.changeset/20338-*.md`. No `packages/metadata-core`, `metadata-protocol` or `spec` edit.
- PR body vs diff: the mechanism, door table, fallback answers, `readCtx` hoist, `stateParam` removal, and the three classes of moved pins all match the diff. One overstatement: the census reddens a new door only when spelled as a `'draft'` comparison or `.previewDrafts` access (above). Ablation and gate numbers were not re-run (by order).
- CI at head `78c4bdfdc`: 35 check-runs, 33 `success`, 2 `skipped` (`Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`), 0 failure, 0 in progress. All seven required contexts `success` (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`).
